BM25 filter keeps only pages relevant to the query

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"bm25_query\":\"rust programming language\",\"bm25_threshold\":0.1,\"content_filter\":\"bm25\",\"max_depth\":1}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.CrawlAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages[0].Html);
```
